LanguageData.VGE_CompactBiosculpterPod.label: compact Big MT rejuvenation pod
LanguageData.VGE_CompactBiosculpterPod.description: A miniaturized Big MT biomedical pod adapted for a Hellion laboratory. It can reverse some effects of aging or perform neurological pleasure calibration, but locks its faster operating cycle to one patient until left unused for 80 days. It draws power from the Hellion reactor.
